n: Kenneth Cole Reaction Back Stage backpack

cs.t: I got this one[0] which comfortably fits my 15" MBP, chargers, display adaptors, umbrella, notebooks, cards, headphones, etc. and is very durable. Sometimes I walk with it for 10-15 kilometers and it is very comfortable to carry around. I got it for ~$100 at a Costco sale. The retail price on the website I linked is so much higher but I recommend checking Costco to see if they still have it. 0:  https://www.luggagepros.com/kenneth-cole-reaction-back-stage...
